name: Manuscript study
one_liner: Turn a scan of handwritten or old sheet music into a study: transcription, piano recording, and the original and transcription playing bar by bar, doubts marked.
stack: Claude Code skill; ABC + abc2midi + fluidsynth; abcjs static page
deploy_target: public GitHub repo + CF Pages per study

kill_criteria.statement: Discovery: KILL if by the deadline no person outside Pavol's family who holds a handwritten manuscript (and Claude Code, or a relative with it) agrees to try the skill on it.

decisions.rationale: Channel named (MetaFilter, MuseScore forum, Fiddlerman posts on hearing handwritten music); landscape finds no tool aligning original bars with a transcription and doubts. Pavol: advance + publish probe.

notes: Prototype: renyi.pages.dev (repo ~/my-git/renyi), built 2026-11-19. Form chosen by Pavol 2026-11-19: open-source skill + template, $0 infra, no API calls. Probe approved 2026-11-19: open-source the pipeline, stage a post for r/ClaudeAI / Show HN; Pavol sends. Repo public 2026-11-19 (CI green). Probe pre-registered in docs/probe.md: PASS = ≥1 outside person tries it or asks for a study, or ≥3 comments describing a manuscript they hold, read 2026-11-28. Posts staged for Pavol: Show HN, then r/ClaudeAI. 2026-11-20: Pavol confirmed Dr. Zoltán Rényi is his grandfather. The concierge probe is live at manuscript-study.dravec.org (send photos, a free study for the first ten). Gate: ≥5 requests from outside the family within 14 days of the first post → build the phone app. Persona: me.dravec.org/manuscript-persona.html. Demand: 64 T1 signals.
